acceptance_criteria.text: app/apps.py holds roles(columns, mapping, typed), RULES = ordered list of (rule id, app, condition) for R1 map, R2 business, R3 explorer, NAMES, detect(...) -> {"app", "rule", "qualifies"} (qualifies in RULES order) and measures(columns, mapping) as in ARCHITECTURE.md 'Round 5: detection'

measures: numerical columns whose name matches amount|revenue|sales|total|price|value|cost|qty|quantity (case-insensitive) first, then the other numerical columns, each group in column order, first 3; element 0 is the primary amount; no match falls back to the first numerical; unit tests: shop.csv gives [revenue, units], measures.csv gives [a, b, c], and a file with columns `a, Total, qty` gives [Total, qty, a]

detect on the archetypes_dir fixtures: shop.csv business/R2 qualifies [business, explorer]; places.csv map/R1 qualifies [map, explorer]; measures.csv explorer/R3 qualifies [explorer]; sparse.csv (lat/lon in 4 of 10 rows, 3 numericals) is not map (explorer/R3)

app/main.py: `_detected(d)` (lru_cache, computed on the unfiltered _base rows), `_shown(d, params)` (valid `app` param only when it is in qualifies, else the detected app), `_appview(d, f, app)` (lru_cache) where only the explorer branch is wired now (business and map branches are added by the Business and Map tickets and return {} until then), and `_view` no longer computes "charts" but returns the filtered typed rows under "typed"

Every current `v["charts"]` use in app/main.py (charts API, dashboard route, both exports) reads `_appview(d, f, "explorer")["charts"]`; /api/datasets/{id}/charts output and the pages are byte-for-byte unchanged (existing tests stay green without edits)

New route GET /api/datasets/{id}/app returns {dataset, app, rule, qualifies, shown, filters, charts (shown app's charts with ids chart-1..N)}; app and rule are always the detected ones, so two requests, and a request with filters, give equal app, rule and qualifies; `?app=map` on shop.csv gives shown business; unknown id gives 404 like the charts route
